subject: Vendor onboarding: sign-in failure after MFA transfer
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara.park@elevatesupplies.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: itops+onboard@elevatesupplies.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unable to sign in to supplier portal after MFA device change

Hi Evelyn,

We completed transferring our MFA to a new phone this morning, and now my account shows a persistent 'session locked' error when I try to accept the supplier portal invitation. The button loads but returns a 403 with an error token in the console (I attached a screenshot). We need the account created this week to receive the PO for next Tuesday.

Details:
- Company: Elevate Supplies
- Portal: Coupa (invite sent from redwood-invite@redwood.com)
- User: sara.park@elevatesupplies.com
- Error: "session_locked: device_mismatch" in network response; screenshots attached.

Can someone help unblock the acceptance flow or resend an activation that avoids the stale session binding?

Thanks,
Sara Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Elevate Supplies
attachments: screenshot-mfa-error.png

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: sara.park@elevatesupplies.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to sign in to supplier portal after MFA device change

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot. Sorry you're hitting this right before the PO deadline.

Ben, Jordan — looping you in for the Coupa invite/session binding angle. The symptoms look like the accept flow is rejecting requests when the device-bound session cookie doesn't match the new MFA device. Can we either:

1) invalidate the pending invite/session for sara.park@elevatesupplies.com so the invite link can be reissued cleanly, or
2) provide a one-time activation URL that bypasses the session binding check for this user (audit-loggable override).

Sara — while we investigate, could you confirm whether anyone forwarded the invite or opened it on a different browser (private mode or mobile)? That can sometimes create a stale relay state.

I'll coordinate on the timing — if we can reissue by tomorrow morning PST we should be fine for the PO.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Program Manager, Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: sara.park@elevatesupplies.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 18:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to sign in to supplier portal after MFA device change

Sara / Evelyn — thanks for the details. I dug into the Coupa accept logs for the invite token tied to sara.park@elevatesupplies.com and see repeated 403s with a session validation mismatch. Two practical options:

- Short term (fastest): I can revoke the current invite token and issue a fresh invite that does not include the previous session state. That avoids touching customer MFA settings. I will also add a note in the invite email to open it in the same browser where they intend to finish the accept flow.

- If the problem persists after a new invite, we should provide a one-time activation link that includes a grace flag for session rebind. That requires a short engineering change and an approval log (I can own it).

Please confirm if we should:
1) Revoke + resend now (I can run this immediately), or
2) Escalate for an activation-link override.

Also Sara, can you attach the browser console log (network tab) and the onboarding form PDF you mentioned? The screenshot helps but the network dump will confirm the failing header/token. If possible, include the approximate clock on your phone when you completed the MFA transfer — clock skew can affect session tokens for a short window.

Thanks — I can do the revoke + resend within 20 minutes once you confirm.

—Ben Carter
Technical Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: none

From: Sara Park <sara.park@elevatesupplies.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, itops+onboard@elevatesupplies.com
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to sign in to supplier portal after MFA device change

Thanks Ben and Evelyn — please do revoke and resend the invite now. I attached:
- elevate_onboarding-form.pdf (completed onboarding form)
- screenshot-mfa-error.png (same as earlier)
- console-log.txt (export from Chrome network tab showing 403/"session_locked: device_mismatch")

Notes:
- MFA transfer completed at approx 08:40 PST this morning.
- Invite was originally opened on my laptop, then I tried to complete on my phone when I got the error.

Jordan — tagging you because our procurement team needs confirmation that the vendor account is active before EOD to meet the PO cutoff. If there's any manual activation step you recommend, happy to follow.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sara Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Elevate Supplies
attachments: elevate_onboarding-form.pdf, screenshot-mfa-error.png, console-log.txt
